city_film.title: Kavey in Chaos City (30 s)
city_film.external_assets: None new. The film reuses the supplied Kavey rig (public/assets/kavey/*.png, cut from kavey_clean.png), the official wordmark (public/assets/kavolt-logo.png) and the FCN storefront crop (public/assets/fcn_crop.png) listed above. Everything else (city, townsfolk, props, holograms, phone, billboard frame, fireworks) is drawn in code (src/city/).
city_film.narration: audio-src/narration_city/c01..c12.wav — Kokoro-82M (Apache-2.0) via kokoro-onnx, stock voice af_heart, natural speed, 'Kavolt' phonemes kəvˈoʊlt; generated by scripts/tts/narrate.py --lines scripts/tts/lines_city.json. Not an imitation of any real person.
city_film.music_and_sfx: Synthesised offline from code (scripts/audio/city/score.ts, scripts/audio/city/sfx.ts); no samples or libraries.
city_film.third_party_names_shown: RAZORPAY and WHATSAPP appear as plain text labels on the payment and reminder holograms (the integrations the plan names); no partner logos are drawn.
